changes: Added one explicitly disposable-loopback-only integration check for current ground-projection history costs and complete-character save/read receipt growth. Production queries, indexes, schemas, saves, receipts and policies are unchanged; the measured query is captured from the actual repository command, not a test-only replacement pipeline.

environment.limits: 1 CPU, 512MiB memory; ephemeral Mongo port32890 bound only to127.0.0.1
environment.data: Only uniquely named synthetic fixture collections. 10,000 expired/100 active valid completed ground records; 100 sparse stored characters across four class labels with1,000 opaque receipt entries each. No connected players, real campaign earnings or production records.

actualMongoCheck.invariants: Pages remain capped, sorted and exclude expired/repeated loot. Every sampled saved map retains its exact keys and fingerprints; Gold12346, EP43, class and level remain unchanged by receipt growth. Empty omitted maps compare by logical contents.
actualMongoCheck.checkCorrection: A first count-only run passed. Strengthening the check with reflect.DeepEqual then failed at zero receipts because BSON omitempty hydrates an empty map as nil. Corrected the test to maps.Equal, preserving the exact-content assertion without inventing a production persistence bug. Final accepted results above are from the corrected source; the failed expanded run is not accepted evidence.

focusedCompatibilityCheck.scope: Current schema22 contiguous catalog, writer fences, unsupported-future-version rejection and mocked bounded/latest-pending recovery queries. Not a new migration, CLI preflight or connected restart acceptance.

growthFinding.observed: A sparse character with10,000 item-delivery receipts is1,460,446 BSON bytes before account metadata, inventory and other receipt families. Save/read costs grow with the full map. Source currently stores characters embedded in the users document and retains permanent item-delivery fingerprints.
growthFinding.externalConstraint: MongoDB documents are limited to16MiB; the embedding account document, not each individual field, must fit.
growthFinding.remainingImplementation: Review a replay-safe scalable receipt/character storage strategy and measure its supported long-lived account shape. Preserve pending recovery, permanent operation identity, old/new writer fences, legacy metadata and restore compatibility. Arbitrary TTL/capping/deleting receipt maps is not an acceptable optimization. No oversized-account failure, lifetime receipt rate or complete solution is claimed by this bounded measurement.

cleanup.result: Test dropped only its uniquely named fixture collections. Exact validated owned container and its two anonymous volumes were then removed; filtered container/volume listings confirm no owned fixture remains. Synthetic fixtures are reproducible from the committed test. No production database, player data, services, DNS or runner configuration changed.

limits: One bounded cold fixture and sequential saves, not latency percentiles, a concurrent100-player promise, a representative fully equipped character catalog or production hardware acceptance.
Standalone storage/read plans do not certify majority replica failover, power loss, a complete dungeon, balance/pacing or campaign progress.

No gratuitous query/index rewrite was made: the existing active-window query passed this retained-history workload. Other query families and receipt-growth implementation remain under1.76 review; compatible earlier recovery proofs should be reused.

No1.76 version/patch-note promotion, push or deployment. Accepted public version remains Alpha1.70.2 at526bc22953e79cbe4869580e8f628d55c39c1b1c. Owner recovery/jump and privacy policies, ordered predecessor publication and later full-roadmap gates remain open.
